relationship: GridAtlas manifest names this geodesy module for measurement. Individual function use in the active runtime is not proven; records describe the module's exported functions.

records.name: distanceKm
records.purpose: Measure distance between two geographic points
records.limits: Uses the estate radius 6378.137 km; not travel distance, route, land access or capacity.

records.name: representativePoint
records.purpose: Choose a representative point for a mapped asset
records.limits: For a polygon uses the arithmetic mean of the outer ring vertices, not a true area centroid; MultiPolygon uses its first polygon.

records.name: voltagesKv
records.purpose: Read mapped voltage values in kilovolts
records.outputs: Distinct positive parsed voltage values, descending, in kV
records.limits: Parses labels; does not establish actual measured voltage, energisation or rating.

records.name: destinationPoint
records.purpose: Calculate a point from a distance and bearing
records.inputs: Longitude, latitude, distance in km, bearing in degrees
records.outputs: Destination longitude and latitude in degrees
records.limits: Spherical calculation; longitude is not normalised and no navigable route is established.

records.name: initialBearingDeg
records.purpose: Calculate the initial bearing between two points
records.outputs: Initial bearing in degrees, normalised to [0,360)
records.limits: Not a device compass reading; coincident or antipodal points do not establish a unique physical heading.
